title: Minimum positive atom
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$ and a probability mass function $p$ on $\Omega$, the minimum positive atom is the minimum of the real-valued masses $p(x)$ over all $x$ with $p(x) \ne 0$, where each mass is viewed as a real number.
